subject: Defo still Open World
author: ZombieTron
body:
In every interview they mention that it is Open World... but it makes me wonder what the Yellow Chevrons mean for me, as I LOVE tracks!

Does it mean that there is a race mode which has designed tracks? I can wait to see.. as it's only a few short months til I get my hands all over hot pursuit.

I am confident that it means it's not ALL Open World ALL of the time. 🤞

subject: Yes, it would be a shame
author: jamm13dodger
body: Yes, it would be a shame to lose open world. We'll need to wait see I suppose.
